reviews.review: I honestly can’t thank the creators of this app enough. reviews.title: Why no way to report birth?
reviews.review: Great app. Have used for years to track my cycle, and found it very helpful when I was trying to conceive and throughout my pregnancy. The one thing that’s missing that I think is a huge oversight is a way to indicate that you have given birth. The FAQ on their website says to just write it in the daily notes section. I have tried so many apps claiming to help track your period, but having to remember to put in the days that you have a period (4-6 days a month) isn’t very useful.
